entities.summary: Don Carlo Caracciolo, 9th Prince of Castagneto, 4th Duke of Melito, was an Italian media publisher. He created Gruppo Editoriale L'Espresso, one of Italy's leading publishing groups, which included Italy's newspaper of record, La Repubblica. He was known as "the editor prince", a reference to his aristocratic birth and elegant manner.
